classification.difficultyReason: Three triangles, each needing the adjacent and hypotenuse identified, a unit conversion (cm and m) in A, and a check of cos against 1/2. More than one triangle can qualify, so each must be tested.

content.prompt: Use the fact that $\cos 60^\circ=\frac{1}{2}$ to determine in which of these triangles the marked angle is $60^\circ$.

answer.worked:
Convert $0.9\text{ m}=90\text{ cm}$ in A. For the marked angle in each triangle:
$$\begin{align*}\text{A: }\frac{\text{Adjacent}}{\text{Hypotenuse}}&=\frac{45}{90}=\frac12\\\text{B: }\frac{\text{Adjacent}}{\text{Hypotenuse}}&=\frac{8.4}{15}=\frac{14}{25}\ne\frac12\\\text{C: }\frac{\text{Adjacent}}{\text{Hypotenuse}}&=\frac{5.7}{11.4}=\frac12\end{align*}$$
So the marked angle is $60^\circ$ in A and C.
